title: Lightning HIIT
description: Plyometric HIIT with tuck jumps, lateral bounds, depth jumps and burpees for lightning cardio

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Side shuffles
exercises.instructions: Fast lateral steps, 3-4 steps each side

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Tuck jumps
exercises.instructions: Jump bringing knees up to the chest

exercises.name: Lateral bounds
exercises.instructions: Powerful lateral jumps from foot to foot

exercises.name: Depth jumps
exercises.instructions: Step off a low platform, touch the ground and jump immediately

exercises.name: Single-leg hops
exercises.instructions: Hop on one leg, stay balanced

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop down, hands on the floor, jump feet back, push-up, jump up

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: Face down, bring the foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
